adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `destinationCalendar` to an array and `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` now loops over multiple destinations (and for COLLECTIVE pushes additional team members’ destination calendars). However, non-Google services still pick only the first destination calendar: e.g. Office365 `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? [];` then uses `mainHostDestinationCalendar.externalId` to build the events URL; Lark does the same in create/update/delete and attendee creation; and the CalDAV/ICS `BaseCalendarService` filters calendars by `mainHostDestinationCalendar.externalId`. In `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents`, when creating events for destination #2+ the same `event` object is passed, so those services will still target destinationCalendar[0]’s externalId (or filter to it), meaning additional hosts’ calendars may not get events (or hit 404 / no-match). Google is the only one updated to select by `credentialId` (`createEvent(calEventRaw, credentialId)` and `.find(cal.credentialId === credentialId)`), so the multi-destination behavior is inconsistent and broken for other integrations.
